title: Bardic Lore
description: You've studied a variety of arcane subjects, including:
pickOne: A Bestiary of Creatures Most Unusual
Grand Histories of the Known World

outcomes.text:
Mark one as active when you choose this Move. You can ask the GM questions about your active subject times per session equal to your int; the GM will answer truthfully.

When you **Make Camp**, you can spend some time studying and/or remembering your training to change your active subject.

title: A Kind of Magic
description: You can **Cast a Spell** + int by combining a verb and a substance from the Wizard's **Enchantment** or **Illusion** Schools.

outcomes.text: To Cast a Spell you need to do a performance. At the start of each session, you get Aether equal to your int. When you **Cast a Spell**, On a 7-9, you can spend Aether equal to the spell's mag instead of the other options.
You get access to the following Roguish Skills. When you apply one of your Roguish Skills, **Defy Danger**+int.

title: Countercharm
description: When you try to impede a mind-influencing effect, roll+int.

outcomes.text: It doesn't affect you or your allies.
You or your allies are unaffected (your call).
It's beyond your ken; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Virtuoso's Mind
description: When you **Spout Lore**, you may ignore the questions and instead roll+int. If you have a relevant record of information, you get **adv** on the roll. On a 12+, you may answer instead of the GM.
